caption.text:
Today, we are honored to debut The Lost Horses: Anthem Film set to Billie Eilish’s Oscar-winning song “What Was I Made For?”

It tells the story of horses who served us, trusted us — and were forgotten.

Every year, tens of thousands of horses — Thoroughbreds, ex–show jumpers, discarded lesson ponies, wild horses, and even donkeys — are lost to the darkness of the export pipeline.

They are companions.  Athletes.  Therapy partners.
Lives who gave everything, only to be thrown away.

And in their final moments, one haunting question lingers: 
What was I made for?

This powerful song carries that truth forward.  Horses have been our partners for centuries — and no life deserves to be discarded.

Thank you, Billie, for sharing your compassion, grace, and artistry with The Lost Horses.  Storytelling combined with advocacy has the extraordinary power to make lasting change in our world.

If this moved you, we ask you to join us in this movement.  Raise your voice, share this film, and take action —
so no horse is ever lost again.

www.losthorses.org

. . .
